blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Visual perception is conventionally formulated as a one-shot prediction from a single glance at the image, under the assumption that the image content and the model’s parametric knowledge suffice to resolve the query.
This assumption often fails in real-world scenarios that hinge on fine-grained visual details or require knowledge-intensive and up-to-date information.
We term such cases perception under insufficient evidence and formulate perception as an agentic process that can obtain information beyond a single glance.
To address the absence of data for this setting, we design two dedicated data generation pipelines, yielding EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K for training.
We further construct EviLens, a human-verified benchmark comprising 688 instances across five perception categories.
Building on these data, we present EviRover, to our knowledge the first perception agent explicitly trained to resolve perceptual queries through interaction, using supervised fine-tuning followed by agentic reinforcement learning.
Experiments show that the 4B EviRover outperforms its backbone by 30 points on average on EviLens, reaching performance comparable to advanced proprietary models.
The gains transfer beyond EviLens to WebEyes, conventional perception benchmarks, and general multimodal benchmarks, including a 15-point improvement on BrowseComp-VL.
All code, models, and data are released.
blocks.zh:
视觉感知通常是作为一弹一弹的预测,从对图像的一眼看,假设图像内容和模型的参数化知识足以解决询问。
这种假设往往在现实世界中失败,这种假设依赖于精细的视觉细节,或需要知识密集型的最新信息。
我们以证据不足来形容这类案件的看法,并将这种看法表述为一种代理程序,可以一目了然地获得信息。
为了解决这一设置缺乏数据的问题,我们设计了两个专用的数据生成管道,生成EviRover-SFT-5K和EviRover-RL-12K供培训使用。
我们进一步构建了EviLens,这是一个经人验证的基准,由5个认知类别的688个实例组成。
根据这些数据,我们向埃维罗弗介绍,据我们所知,第一感知剂被明确培训,通过互动,利用监督的微调,然后进行促进性强化学习,解决知觉问题。
实验显示,4B EviRover在EviLens上平均比它的骨干功率高出30分,达到了与高级专有模型相当的性能.
收益从EviLens转移到WebEyes、常规认知基准和一般多式联运基准,包括对浏览Comp-VL的15点改进。
所有代码,模型,和数据都发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have progressed rapidly in reasoning and tool use ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) .
These advances have enabled multimodal agents to address increasingly complex visual questions through multi-step interaction ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ; Chu et al., 2026 ; Jiao et al., 2026 ) .
Yet in most such systems, agentic interaction serves question answering rather than perceptual prediction.
Perception tasks themselves have largely retained their conventional formulation ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Tang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Pacini et al., 2026 ) .
Grounding, segmentation, and counting are still commonly treated as one-shot predictions from an image-query pair, based on a single glance at the input image.
This formulation assumes that the image and the model’s parametric knowledge are sufficient to resolve the query.
In practice, fine-grained visual details may require closer inspection, while identifying the target may depend on knowledge beyond the image.
We refer to such cases as perception under insufficient evidence .
In these settings, a single glance is insufficient to determine the required perceptual output, yet the model must still produce a location, a boundary, or a count without the opportunity for further search.
blocks.zh:
多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在推理和工具使用方面迅速取得进展(Ma等人,2025年;Feng等人,2026年;Du等人,2026年;Yan等人,2026年)。
这些进展使多式联运代理人能够通过多步骤互动解决日益复杂的视觉问题(黄等人,2026年;范等人,2026年;朱等人,2026年;焦等人,2026年)。
然而,在大多数这种系统中,代理式互动服务于回答问题,而不是概念性预测。
感知任务本身基本上保留了其常规配方(王等人,2026b;唐等人,2026b;王等人,2026a;邓等人,2026;帕西尼等人,2026).
平地,分块,计数仍被普遍视为一弹一弹的预测,来自一弹一弹的图像清空对映,基于对输入图像的一视.
这种提法假定图像和模型的参数化知识足以解决查询.
在实践中,精细的视觉细节可能需要更仔细的检查,而识别目标可能取决于图像以外的知识.
我们把这类案件称为证据不足的认知。
在这些设置中,一览不足以确定所需的知觉输出,然而模型仍然必须产生一个位置,边界,或者一个没有机会进行进一步搜索的计数.

blocks.en:
We therefore reformulate perception under insufficient evidence as an evidence-seeking process.
Rather than predicting directly from the initial observation, the model can search through finer-grained visual inspection or external knowledge sources to resolve the perceptual task.
Whereas existing multimodal agents ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) gather evidence to support a textual answer, the proposed formulation treats the perceptual output itself as the objective.
This makes perception a stricter test of evidence seeking: in question answering, searched evidence can be converted directly into a textual answer, whereas in perception it must be translated into a location, a boundary, or a count on the input image, which demands fine-grained visual understanding.
Moreover, the perceptual output is directly verifiable against spatial or numerical annotations, and is correct only if the agent both acquires the missing evidence and correctly relates it to the visual content.
Perception is also of considerable practical value, as accurate perception underpins downstream applications such as embodied manipulation ( Zhang et al., 2024a ; Kim et al., 2026 ) and image editing ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
Despite these advantages, agentic perception poses a central challenge: the missing evidence varies across queries. A small target calls for closer inspection, whereas an unfamiliar identity calls for external search. Deciding what to acquire and how is therefore part of the task rather than a fixed procedure.
Recent prompt-based workflows ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026a ) have begun to incorporate web search into perception.
However, they rely on manually designed prompting strategies at inference time, so their searching behavior is bounded by human-designed heuristics rather than learned from task feedback. Liang et al. (2026) train an agent that interleaves reasoning with web search. But it is limited to segmentation and assumes that missing evidence is always external knowledge.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们将证据不足的观念重新表述为寻找证据的过程。
该模型不是直接从初步观测中预测,而是可以通过更精细的视觉检查或外部知识来源进行搜索,以解决感知任务.
现有的多式联运代理商(Huang等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2025年)收集证据支持文字答案,而拟议配方则将知觉输出本身视为目标.
这使感知成为更严格地检验寻求证据:在回答问题时,被搜索的证据可以直接转化为文字答案,而在感知中,它必须转化为一个位置,一个边界,或者一个输入图像的计数,这需要精细的视觉理解.
此外,知觉输出可以直接对照空间或数值说明进行可核查,只有在代理人既获得缺失的证据,又将其与视觉内容正确联系起来的情况下才正确.
观念也具有相当的实际价值,因为准确的观念支持下游应用,如隐含的操纵(Zhang等人,2024a); Kim等人,2026年)和图像编辑(Liu等人,2024a; 刘等, 2026).
尽管有这些优势,代理感提出了中心挑战:缺失的证据因询问而异. 一个小目标需要更密切的检查,而一个不熟悉的身份则需要外部搜索。 因此,决定获得什么以及如何获得,不是固定程序的一部分。
最近的即时工作流程 (Yang等人,2026年;Tang等人,2026a)开始将网络搜索纳入认知.
然而,他们依赖于人工设计的推论时间的提示策略,因此他们的搜索行为被人类设计的heuristic所约束,而不是从任务反馈中学习. 梁某等人(2026年)培养代理商,将推理与网络搜索交互. 但仅限于分化,假定缺失的证据总是外部知识.

blocks.en: Inspired by recent developments in agentic reinforcement learning for visual question answering ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) , we ask: can we train agents to learn when and how to search to push perception beyond a single glance?
blocks.zh: 受最近为视觉问题解答而进行代理强化学习的发展(郑等人,2026年;吴等人,2026年;洪等人,2026年)的启发,我们问:我们是否可以训练特工们学会何时以及如何进行搜索,将认知推向一目了然?

blocks.en: Figure 1: Representative examples from our training data and the EviLens benchmark.
blocks.zh: 图1:我们的培训数据和EviLens基准中有代表性的例子。

blocks.en:
To answer this question, we introduce EviRover, to our knowledge the first agent trained to search both within and beyond the image to resolve perceptual queries.
EviRover moves beyond a single glance : at each step, it decides whether further evidence is needed and which action can provide it, before producing a location, a boundary, or a count.
As existing perception datasets do not cover this setting, we design two data generation pipelines, each targeting one form of evidence insufficiency.
For evidence present in the image but not discernible at a glance, we collect high-resolution images with targets occupying less than 0.1% of the image area, together with scenes requiring multi-step visual exploration, such as I-spy and spot-the-difference puzzles.
For evidence beyond the image, we construct queries over group photographs of public figures and anime characters through two procedures:
(1) starting from group photographs and verifying the identities of the depicted individuals; and (2) starting from a reference image of a known individual or character and synthesizing a group photograph containing them with GPT-Image-2 ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , followed by filtering with Seed-2.0-Pro ( Seed, 2026b ) for visual quality and identity preservation.
These pipelines yield two training sets, EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K, and EviLens, a human-verified benchmark of 688 instances spanning segmentation, counting, and three grounding categories: localization, recognition, and spot-the-difference.
Figure 1 presents representative examples.
blocks.zh:
为了回答这个问题,我们向埃维罗弗介绍,根据我们的知识,第一个经过训练的特工在图像内外搜索,以解决感知性询问。
EviRover超越了一目了然:在每一步,它决定是否需要进一步的证据,以及可以采取哪些行动来提供证据,然后提出地点、边界或计数。
由于现有的感知数据集没有涵盖这个设定,我们设计了两个数据生成管道,每个管道针对一种形式的证据不足.
对于图像中存在但一眼看不见的证据,我们收集高分辨率图像,目标占图像面积不到0.1%,以及需要多步视觉探索的场景,如I-spy和Spot-the-difference谜题.
对于图像以外的证据,我们通过两个程序在公众人物和动画人物的集体照片上构建查询:
(1)从集体照片开始,核实被描绘个人的身份;(2)从已知个人或人物的参考图像开始,用GPT-Image-2(OpenAI,2026b)合成载有他们的团体照片,然后用Seed-2.0-Pro(种子,2026b)过滤,以进行视觉质量和身份保护.
这些管道提供了两套培训,即EviRover-SFT-5K和EviRover-RL-12K,以及EviLens,这是经过人验证的基准,共有688个实例,跨越了分区、计数和三个地面类别:本地化、识别和即时分辨。
图1提供了有代表性的例子。

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of EviRover.
On EviLens, EviRover improves over its Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct backbone by 30 points on average across the five categories, bringing a 4B model to a level comparable with advanced proprietary models such as Seed-2.1-turbo and Gemini-3.5-Flash.
We also evaluate on WebEyes ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , a benchmark for search-based grounding, segmentation, and visual question answering, where EviRover improves over its backbone by 14.4 IoU on grounding and 24.7 gIoU on segmentation.
The gains further extend beyond our setting: EviRover consistently improves on conventional perception benchmarks such as ReasonSeg ( Lai et al., 2024 ) and RefCOCOg ( Mao et al., 2016 ; Nagaraja et al., 2016 ) , as well as general multimodal benchmarks, including MMMU ( Yue et al., 2024 ) , MMMU-Pro ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , and MathVerse ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) , with a 15-point gain on BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2026 ) .
These results indicate that learning to search under insufficient evidence not only enhances perception but also yields capabilities that generalize well beyond the training distribution.
blocks.zh:
广泛的实验证明了EviRover的有效性.
在EviLens上,EviRover比其Qune3-VL-4B-指令骨干平均提升了5个类别的30分,使4B模型达到与种子-2.1-涡轮和双子座-3.5-Flash等先进专利模型相当的水平.
我们还在WebEyes(Yang等人,2026年)上评价,这是基于搜索的地面、分区和视觉问题回答的基准,EviRover在地面上用14.4IoU改进,在分区上用24.7gIoU改进。
这些成果进一步超越了我们的设定: EviRover不断改进常规认知基准,如ReasonSeg(Lai等人,2024年)和RefCOCOg(Mao等人,2016年;Nagaraja等人,2016年),以及一般多式联运基准,包括MMMU(Yue等人,2024年),MMMU-Pro(Yue等人,2025年)和MathVerse(Zhang等人,2024年b),其浏览Cont-VL(Geng等人,2026年)的15点收益。
这些结果表明,在证据不足的情况下学习搜索不仅能增强认知,而且能产生超出培训分布范围的一般能力。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • We identify perception under insufficient evidence and reformulate perception as an evidence-seeking process that looks beyond a single glance . • We present EviRover , to our knowledge the first perception agent trained to determine what evidence is missing and how to acquire it. • To address the absence of data for perception under insufficient evidence, we design two dedicated data generation pipelines, yielding EviRover-SFT-5K , EviRover-RL-12K , and EviLens , a human-verified benchmark of 688 instances. • Extensive experiments validate EviRover: it improves over its backbone by 30 points on average on EviLens and generalizes to WebEyes, conventional perception benchmarks, and general multimodal benchmarks.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们把证据不足的观念确定为一种寻找证据的过程,不能一目了然。 我们向埃维罗弗介绍,据我们所知,第一个认识代理人受过培训,以确定缺少哪些证据以及如何获取证据。 为了解决在证据不足的情况下缺乏感知数据的问题,我们设计了两条专用数据生成管道,生成了EviRover-SFT-5K、EviRover-RL-12K和EviLens,这是688例经人验证的基准。 • 广泛的实验验证了EviRover:它在EviLens的骨干上平均提高了30分,并概括到WebEyes、传统认知基准和一般多式联运基准。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Grounding ( Kamath et al., 2021 ) , segmentation ( Hu et al., 2016 ) , and counting ( Amini-Naieni et al., 2023 ) are conventionally formulated as predicting a location, a boundary, or a count from an image and a query.
Beyond specialized detectors ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , segmentation models ( Carion et al., 2025 ) , and counting models ( Amini-Naieni et al., 2024 ) , MLLM-based methods extend these tasks to free-form queries requiring reasoning ( Lai et al., 2024 ; You & Wu, 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) .
In parallel, a growing body of work has focused specifically on fine-grained perception of small objects in high-resolution images ( Goto et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) .
However, these advances retain the one-shot formulation, in which the evidence needed to resolve the query is assumed to be present in the input image.
Our work lifts this assumption, allowing the perceptual prediction to draw on evidence acquired beyond a single glance at the image.
blocks.zh:
地面(Kamath等人,2021年),分区 (Hu et al., 2016),和计数(Amini-Naieni et al., 2023)按常规表述为预测一个位置,一个边界,或从一个图像和一个查询中算出一个计数.
除了专门的探测器(Liu等人,2024年b),分区模型(Carion等人,2025年)和计数模型(Amini-Naieni等人,2024年)之外,基于MLLM的方法将这些任务扩展到需要推理的自由式查询(Lai等人,2024年;You & Wu,2025年;Liu等人,2025年)。
与此同时,越来越多的工作特别侧重于高分辨率图像中对小物体的精细感知(Goto等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年;Jia等人,2026年)。
然而,这些进步保留了一弹一弹的提法,其中假定解决查询所需的证据存在于输入图像中.
我们的工作解除了这一假设,使感知预测能够利用从图像中一目了然获得的证据。

blocks.en:
A broad class of visual questions cannot be resolved from the image and the model’s parametric knowledge alone ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) .
One line of work, often referred to as thinking with images ( Su et al., 2025 ) , enables models to actively inspect image regions through operations such as zooming and cropping ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Wu & Xie, 2024 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
Another line develops multimodal search agents that acquire external knowledge through web search, progressing from short-horizon search to long-horizon deep research ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Geng et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) .
However, these works acquire evidence to produce textual answers, treating perception as a means rather than an end.
Recent attempts extend search to segmentation and grounding ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026a ; Liang et al., 2026 ) , but either rely on manually designed prompting or restrict evidence seeking to external search for a specific task.
In contrast, our work treats perception as the goal of evidence seeking, where the acquired evidence must be resolved into a perceptual prediction on the input image.
Since the kind of evidence a query lacks varies, deciding what to acquire and how becomes an integral part of the task.
blocks.zh:
光是图像和模型的参数化知识无法解决一大批视觉问题(Chen等人,2023年;Zeng等人,2026年;Choi等人,2026年)。
一线工作,常被称为用图像思考(Su等人,2025年),使模型能够通过放大和裁剪等操作积极检查图像区域(郑等人,2026年;吴和谢等人,2024年;郭等人,2026年;张等人,2025年).
另一条线路发展出通过网络搜索获得外部知识的多式联运搜索代理,从短视搜索向长视深度研究发展(吴等,2026;耿等,2026;黄等,2026;姚等,2026).
然而,这些作品获得了提供文字答案的证据,将感知视为一种手段而非目的.
近期尝试将搜索扩展到分解和地面(Yang等人,2026年;Tang等人,2026年a;Liang等人,2026年),但要么依靠人工设计的提示,要么限制寻求外部搜索的具体任务的证据.
与此相反,我们的工作将感知视为寻找证据的目标,即所获取的证据必须解决成对输入图像的感知预测。
由于询问缺乏的证据种类不同,因此决定获取什么以及如何成为任务的一个组成部分。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集建设

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , we design two dedicated data generation pipelines targeting different forms of missing evidence.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们设计了两条专门的数据生成管道,针对不同形式的缺失证据。

blocks.en:
We collect high-resolution images containing targets so small that they cannot be resolved without inspecting the image at a finer scale,
in many cases occupying well under 0.1% of the image area,
together with images where the target can only be found by comparing or scanning multiple regions,
such as I-spy and spot-the-difference scenes.
Images are adapted from Mini-o3 ( Lai et al., 2026a ) and collected from the web through image search.

图像改编自Mini-o3(Lai等人,2026a),通过图像搜索从网上收集.

blocks.en: We construct perception queries over group photographs of people, including public figures and anime characters, through two complementary procedures.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两个互补的程序,对包括公众人物和动画人物在内的人群照片进行感知查询。

blocks.en:
The first collects real group photographs and verifies the identities of the people they depict.
We begin from a manually written seed list of 85 event categories spanning award ceremonies, music groups, esports competitions, political summits, product launches, academic events, sports competitions, and entertainment programs.
We prompt Seed-1.8 to expand each category into concrete search queries, which are then issued to an image search engine to obtain group photographs and their associated captions.
However, captions are an unreliable source of identity annotations, as they are absent for most collected images and frequently incomplete or inaccurate when present.
We therefore verify identities independently using Seed-2.0-Pro equipped with web search tools.
blocks.zh:
第一部收集真实的团体照片,并验证他们所描绘的人的身份.
包括颁奖仪式、音乐团体、体育比赛、政治峰会、产品发布、学术活动、体育比赛和娱乐节目。
我们鼓励Seed-1.8将每个类别扩展为具体的搜索查询,然后发布到图像搜索引擎,以获取组照片及其相关字幕.
然而,标题是身份说明的不可靠来源,因为大多数收集的图像没有标题,而且往往不完全或不准确。
因此,我们使用配备网络搜索工具的种子2.0-Pro独立验证身份。

blocks.en:
The second procedure starts from a reference image of a known individual or character and synthesizes a group photograph containing that individual.
Since single-person images with verifiable identities are far more abundant than group photographs in which every identity can be verified, this procedure covers a substantially broader range of identities.
We initially explored conditioning generation on multiple verified reference images simultaneously.
For real individuals, identity preservation degrades sharply as the number of references increases, remaining reliable for only up to approximately three references.
Beyond this number, the generated individuals can no longer be reliably matched to their references through reverse image search, a failure further confirmed by manual inspection.
Anime characters, in contrast, are defined by distinctive visual traits such as hairstyles and costumes, and remain well preserved under multi-reference conditioning.
We therefore condition each generation of real individuals on a single reference identity while leaving the other individuals in the scene unconstrained, and condition anime generation on multiple character references.
The images are synthesized with GPT-Image-2 and filtered by Seed-2.0-Pro, which assesses visual quality and verifies identity preservation by searching for the generated individual and confirming that the results match the reference identity.
blocks.zh:
第二种程序从已知个人或人物的参考图像开始,合成包含该个人的团体照片.
由于具有可核实身份的单人图像远比能够验证每个身份的团体照片更丰富,因此这一程序涵盖范围要广得多的身份。
我们首先探索了同时在多个经核实的参考图像上进行调制生成。
对于真正的个人来说,随着参考文献数量的增加,身份保护急剧下降,仅对大约3个参考文献来说仍然可靠。
除了这个数字之外,生成的个人再也无法通过反向图像搜索可靠地与其参考物匹配,人工检查进一步证实了这一失败.
相比之下,Anime字符是由发型和服饰等显著的视觉特征定义的,在多参考条件下保存良好.
因此,我们把每代真实的个体以单一的参考身份作为条件,同时让现场中的其他个体不受限制,把动漫代以多个字符参考作为条件.
图像由GPT-Image-2合成,由Seed-2.0-Pro过滤,通过搜索生成的个人,确认结果与参考身份相符,评估视觉质量,验证身份保存.

blocks.en: The two procedures thus yield group photographs with different levels of identity coverage: real photographs may have some or all depicted individuals verified, synthesized photographs of real individuals contain exactly one verified individual, and synthesized anime images may contain multiple verified characters.
blocks.zh: 因此,这两种程序产生了身份覆盖程度不同的集体照片:真实照片可能包含一些或所有被描绘的个人得到核实,真实个人的合成照片包含一个经过核实的个人,而合成的动画图像可能包含多个经过核实的字符。

blocks.en:
The verified identities serve as ground truth for query construction.
Grounding and segmentation queries require at least one verified identity per image, which serves as the target to be localized or segmented.
Counting queries require every depicted individual to be verified, and are formulated over attributes shared among them, such as affiliation with a particular institution or receipt of a particular honor.
blocks.zh:
经核实的身份可作为查询构造的地面真相。
定位和分区查询要求每个图像至少有一个经核实的身份,而这种身份是本地化或分区化的目标。
盘点询问要求每个被描绘的个人都得到核实,并且根据他们之间共有的属性,如隶属某一机构或获得某一荣誉。

blocks.en:
In their initial form, these queries name the target directly, for example by asking for the mask of a specific individual.
A model that recognizes the named individual can resolve such queries without seeking any additional evidence.
To make evidence seeking necessary, we rewrite each query into a multi-hop form through iterative entity replacement.
At each step, we select an entity in the current query, obtain its public profile through a search engine, and prompt GPT-5.4-mini to replace the entity with an indirect description that identifies it without naming it.
The replacement terminates once Seed-1.8 can no longer resolve the query without tools, with a maximum of 20 hops.
blocks.zh:
这些查询在初始形式中直接点出目标名称,例如要求特定个人的面具.
一种承认被点名的个人的模式可以解决这种询问,而不寻求任何补充证据。
为了使寻找证据成为必要,我们通过迭代实体替换将每个查询重写成多跳形式.
在每一步,我们都会在目前的查询中选择一个实体,通过搜索引擎获取其公开的剖面,并促使GPT-5.4-mini用一个间接描述来代替该实体,以识别它而不命名.
一旦Seed-1.8无法在没有工具的情况下解决查询,替换终止,最多20 hop.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Tool-use composition of EviRover-SFT-5K.
blocks.zh: 图4:EviRover-SFT-5K的工具使用构成。

blocks.en:
We generate agent trajectories for the constructed queries, using Gemini-3.0-Pro for localization queries and Seed-2.0-Pro for the remaining tasks, and retain only those that reach the correct answer through a logically consistent sequence of actions.
Correctness alone, however, does not ensure that a trajectory exhibits the intended behavior.
For example, queries about widely recognized individuals are often resolved by a single search or directly from parametric knowledge, involving little evidence seeking.
We therefore downsample such trajectories while retaining a portion of them, so that the model learns both to answer directly when its knowledge suffices and to seek evidence when it does not.
Figure 4 shows the resulting composition of EviRover-SFT-5K.
blocks.zh:
我们为构造的查询生成代理轨迹,使用双子座-3.0-Pro进行本地化查询,为剩余任务生成种子2.0-Pro,仅保留通过逻辑上一致的动作序列获得正确答案的代理轨迹.
然而,仅靠正确性并不能确保轨迹显示预期行为。
例如,关于被广泛承认的个人的询问往往通过单一的搜索或直接从参数化知识中解决,涉及寻求的证据很少.
因此,我们降低这种轨迹的样本,同时保留其中的一部分,以便模型既学会在知识足够时直接回答,又学会在知识不够时寻找证据。
图4显示EviRover-SFT-5K的构成。

blocks.en: Together, these procedures yield two training sets, EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K.
blocks.zh: 这些程序共同产生了两套培训,EviRover-SFT-5K和EviRover-RL-12K。

blocks.en: 3.2 EviLens
blocks.zh: 3.2 埃维林斯

blocks.en:
We construct EviLens with the pipelines above and manually verify every instance, yielding a benchmark of 688 instances for evaluating perception under insufficient evidence.
It covers segmentation, counting, and three grounding categories that differ in the type of missing evidence. Localization targets are explicitly named but tiny or hidden among clutter, as in high-resolution scenes and I-spy puzzles. Recognition targets are visually salient but referred to indirectly, requiring external information to identify. Spot-the-difference targets are defined relative to a second panel and require cross-panel comparison. Segmentation and counting share the recognition setting but output masks and counts, respectively.
blocks.zh:
我们用上面的管道构建了EviLens系统,并人工核查每个实例,得出了在证据不足的情况下评价认知的688个实例的基准。
它包括分割,计数,以及三个不同类型缺失证据的基数类别. 本地化的目标被明确命名,但很小或隐藏在杂乱无章中,例如在高分辨率场景和I-spy谜题中. 识别目标明显,但间接提及,需要外部信息加以识别。 Spot-the-difference目标相对于第二个面板进行定义,需要跨面板比较. 区分和计数分别分享识别设置,但输出口罩和计数.

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares EviLens with existing benchmarks in task coverage and required abilities.
EviLens contains 140 localization, 182 recognition, 15 spot-the-difference, 195 segmentation, and 156 counting instances, with the spot-the-difference instances comprising 79 annotated differences in total.
blocks.zh:
表1 比较 具备任务范围和所需能力的现有基准。
EviLens包含140个本地化,182个识别,15个即时偏差,195个区块,156个计数例,即时偏差例包含79个注解的总差异.

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of EviLens with existing perception benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表1:EviLens与现有认知基准的比较。

blocks.en:
Recognition and localization are evaluated by mean box IoU and R@0.5.
Segmentation is evaluated by gIoU (mean per-instance IoU) and cIoU (cumulative intersection over cumulative union).
Counting is evaluated by exact-match accuracy.
Spot-the-difference is evaluated by micro- and macro-F1 under greedy one-to-one matching at IoU 0.5, where micro-F1 pools matches across images and macro-F1 averages per-image scores.
blocks.zh:
识别和本地化通过IoU和R@0.5的中间框评价。
分化由gIoU(平均偶联IoU)和cIoU(累积结合比累积结合相交)评估.
计数通过精确的匹配精度来评价.
Spot-the-difference在IoU 0.5中通过贪婪的一对一比对下由微观和宏观F1来评价,其中微观F1池在图像之间匹配,宏观F1的每个图像平均得分.

blocks.en: 3.3 Model Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 示范培训

blocks.en:
We train EviRover in two stages.
SFT establishes the interaction format and basic tool-use skills, while RL teaches the model to identify what evidence each query lacks and how to acquire it, using the correctness of the final perceptual output as feedback.
blocks.zh:
我们分两个阶段训练埃维罗弗
SFT建立互动格式和基本工具使用技能,而RL则教模型识别每个查询缺少哪些证据以及如何获得,使用最终感知输出的正确性作为反馈.

blocks.en:
EviRover operates with a set of ten tools, shared across trajectory labeling, training, and evaluation.
Four tools acquire external evidence: text search, text-to-image search, image search, and web browsing.
Three tools support fine-grained visual inspection, such as cropping a region for closer examination and rendering a candidate region on the original image for verification.
The remaining three support task-specific prediction: SAM3-based mask generation, side-by-side region comparison for spot-the-difference queries, and a Python interpreter.
Table 6 summarizes the available tools; detailed specifications and complete tool schemas are provided in Appendix A.5.2 .
blocks.zh:
EviRover使用一套十种工具,在轨迹标签、培训和评价之间共享。
有四个工具获得外部证据:文本搜索、文本到图像搜索、图像搜索和网页浏览。
三种工具支持精细的目视检查,例如将一个区域划为更接近检查的区域,并使一个候选区域在原始图像上进行核查。
其余三个支持任务特异性预测:基于SAM3的面具生成,用于点-偏差查询的侧面区域比较,以及一个Python解释器.
表6概述了现有工具;附录A.5.2提供了详细规格和完整的工具计划。

blocks.en:
We fine-tune Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct on EviRover-SFT-5K (Section 3.1 ) to initialize tool use and task-specific prediction.
The loss is computed only over model-generated tokens, with tool observations masked.
blocks.zh:
我们对EviRover-SFT-5K上的Quen3-VL-4B-指示(第3.1节)进行微调,以初始化工具使用和任务特定预测.
损失只通过模型生成的代号计算,并掩盖工具观察。

Since the training data span heterogeneous perception tasks with substantially different reward distributions, we adopt EMA-GRPO ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , which maintains task-specific running reward statistics to normalize the learning signal across tasks.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Training and Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训和评价设置

blocks.en:
We initialize from Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and train on a single node of 8 NVIDIA A800-80GB GPUs with FSDP.
Both stages use AdamW ( β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) , weight decay 0.01 0.01 ) with gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 .
Supervised fine-tuning uses a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} under a cosine schedule with warmup ratio 0.03 0.03 , a global batch size of 64 64 , and 2 2 epochs.
Reinforcement learning uses a constant learning rate without warmup, and samples 8 8 rollouts for each of 8 8 prompts per step, giving 64 64 rollouts per step divided into 4 4 mini-batches for the policy update.

We evaluate primarily on EviLens, and additionally on WebEyes, a search-based grounding, segmentation and VQA benchmark.
All methods receive the same input prompt (Appendix A.5.1 ) and use the same task-specific output interfaces, with coordinates normalized to [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] and boxes in xyxy format.
Direct baselines predict a box from the image and query in a single pass; segmentation converts the predicted box into a mask with SAM3, and counting returns an integer.
Agentic baselines and EviRover additionally have access to the tool framework of Section 3.3 , with a limit of 35 tool calls per trajectory.
Further details are given in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们主要在EviLens以及WebEyes上进行评估,这是基于搜索的地面、分区和VQA基准。
所有方法都得到相同的输入提示(Appendix A.5.1),并使用相同的任务特定输出接口,坐标正常化为[0,1000][0,100],框格式为xyxy.
直接基线从图像和查询中以单传预测一个框;分割将预测的框转换成带有SAM3的遮罩,计数返回一个整数.
代理基线和EviRover还可以使用第3.3节的工具框架,每个轨迹只能调用35个工具。
详情见附录A.3。

blocks.en: 4.2 Performance Analysis on EviLens
blocks.zh: 4.2 对EviLens的性能分析

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 2 , EviLens is challenging for all model families.
Among proprietary models, Gemini-3.5-Flash, Seed-2.1-Turbo, and GPT-5.6-Sol perform best overall.
Gemini-3.5-Flash and Seed-2.1-Turbo lead on recognition and counting, and Seed-2.1-Turbo achieves the highest segmentation score of any model ( 0.779 0.779 gIoU).
GPT-5.6-Sol performs notably poorly on spot-the-difference, achieving a micro-F1 of only 0.112, as it consistently predicts a single bounding box even when the prompt indicates multiple differences.
blocks.zh:
如表2所示,EviLens对所有模范家庭都具有挑战性。
在专有型号中,双子座3.5-Flash,种子-2.1-Turbo,GPT-5.6-Sol总体表现最好.
双子座3.5-Flash和种子-2.1-Turbo领先于识别和计数,种子-2.1-Turbo实现了任意型号(0.779 0.779 gIoU)的最高分化分数.
GPT-5.6-Sol在当场偏移时表现明显不佳,其微F1的功率仅为0.112,因为即使提示显示多重差异,它也始终如一地预测单个边框.

blocks.en: Table 2: Evaluation results on EviLens.
blocks.zh: 表2:EviLens的评价结果。

blocks.en: Table 3: Evaluation results on the WebEyes benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表3:在WebEyes基准上的评价结果。

blocks.en:
Open-source models perform substantially worse.
Despite strong results on conventional perception benchmarks, segmentation specialists reach at most 0.343 gIoU, and grounding specialists achieve near-zero IoU on localization.
General-purpose open-source MLLMs exhibit similarly limited performance.
The difficulty of EviLens therefore lies not in perceptual precision but in acquiring the evidence each query lacks, a capability that existing perception benchmarks do not evaluate.
blocks.zh:
开源模型的运行情况要糟糕得多。
尽管在传统认知基准方面取得了显著成果,但分化专家最多达到0.343千焦耳,而分化专家则在本地化方面达到接近零千焦耳。
通用开源MLLMs也表现出同样有限的性能.
因此,EviLens的难度不在于概念上的精确性,而在于获取每个查询缺乏的证据,而这种能力是现有的感知基准不加以评价的。

blocks.en:
Against this backdrop, EviRover achieves the best localization and recognition results of all evaluated models, with a clear margin on localization ( 0.444 0.444 IoU versus 0.373 0.373 for Gemini-3.5-Flash), and ranks second on segmentation behind Seed-2.1-Turbo.
On counting and spot-the-difference, where its backbone scores 19.2 19.2 and 0.005 0.005 respectively, EviRover surpasses most proprietary models, coming within 1.3 1.3 points of GPT-5.6-Sol on counting.
Relative to its backbone, EviRover improves the primary metric of every category, by 30.2 30.2 points on average, bringing a 4B model to a level comparable with the strongest proprietary systems.
blocks.zh:
在此背景下,EviRover实现了所有被评价模型的最佳本地化和识别结果,在本地化方面有明显的差值(双子座-3.5-Flash的0.444 0.444对0.373 0.373),在分化方面排在种子-2.1-Turbo之后的第二位.
EviRover在计算和当场偏差时,其主干分别得分为19.2 19.2和0.005 0.005,超过了大多数专有型号,在计时时时在GPT-5.6-Sol的1.3分以内.
相对于其骨干,EviRover改进了每个类别的主要度量衡,平均提高30.2 30.2分,使4B模型达到与最强的专利系统相当的水平.

blocks.en: 4.3 Performance on WebEyes
blocks.zh: 4.3 在WebEyes上的表现

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports results on WebEyes, where baseline results are taken from the original paper and bold marks the best result among open-source models.

blocks.en:
To examine whether evidence-seeking training affects standard perception, we evaluate EviRover on grounding and segmentation in ReasonSeg and RefCOCOg (Table 4 ).
EviRover improves over its backbone on every split and metric, and outperforms task-specific models on most metrics, such as Seg-Zero-7B on segmentation and Perception-R1 on grounding.
The capabilities acquired through evidence-seeking training thus carry over to conventional perception.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we study perception under insufficient evidence, where a single glance at the image does not suffice to resolve the query.
We reformulate perception in this setting as an evidence-seeking process.
To support this formulation, we develop two dedicated data generation pipelines and construct EviLens, a human-verified benchmark for evaluating perception under insufficient evidence.
Building on these data, we train EviRover to actively seek the missing evidence required by each query through supervised fine-tuning followed by agentic reinforcement learning.
Experiments show that EviRover substantially improves over its backbone on EviLens and WebEyes, and that these gains extend to conventional perception and general multimodal benchmarks.
These results suggest that perception can move beyond a single glance: learning to identify and acquire missing evidence improves perceptual accuracy and yields evidence-seeking capabilities that generalize to broader multimodal reasoning.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们在证据不足的情况下研究观念,即只要一看图像就不足以解决问题。
我们在此背景下将观念重新定位为寻找证据的过程。
为了支持这一表述,我们开发了两条专用的数据生成管道,并建造了EviLens,这是在证据不足的情况下评价感知的经人验证的基准。
在这些数据的基础上,我们培训EviRover,通过监督的微调,然后进行代理强化学习,积极寻找每个查询所需的缺失证据。
实验表明,EviRover在EviLens和WebEyes的骨干上大有改进,这些收益延伸到传统观念和一般多式联运基准。
这些结果表明,感知可以超越一目了然:学会识别和获取缺失证据可提高认知准确性,并产生寻找证据的能力,从而通向更广泛的多式联运推理。

Trajectories in which the annotation model answers directly, or verifies its answer with only a single tool call, typically reflect knowledge that the annotation model already possesses.

blocks.en:
The segmentation reward requires SAM3 to return a mask for the predicted box and point prompts.
When SAM3 fails to produce a mask, we do not assign zero reward.
Under group-relative advantage estimation, a zero reward is not a neutral outcome: it enters the group mean and shifts the advantages of every other rollout for the same prompt, so a tool failure unrelated to prediction quality would corrupt the learning signal for the rest of the group.
We instead treat the predicted box as a rectangular mask and compute the IoU against the ground truth, which preserves the ordering of rollouts by localization quality while remaining a strict lower bound on what SAM3 would have returned.
Trajectories scored this way are flagged in the training metadata so that the fallback rate can be monitored.

Each accepted pair counts as a true positive.
Precision, recall, and F1 are then computed from the resulting counts.

Each instance is evaluated over eight rollouts, and both metrics are averaged across rollouts.

Pay attention to fine details , small text , subtle attributes , relative position , precise boundaries , and local context . - Use tools strategically to reduce uncertainty . - Use ‘ crop ‘ to inspect small or unclear regions . - Use ‘ verify ‘ to check global placement on the full image : whether the candidate box is on the correct object instance , in the correct relative location , and at the right overall scale . - Use ‘ verify_part ‘ to check local content and tightness : whether the box really contains the target , includes all of it , and is not too loose . - Your bounding box must tightly fit the target — avoid overly large boxes . A good bbox should contain the target and little else . - For spot - the - difference tasks : differences are often SMALL and subtle ( colors , shapes , missing / added elements ). All bounding boxes must be on the LEFT panel only ( x coordinates in range 0-500). Confirm each candidate with ‘ compare_lr ‘ before reporting it , and drop the ones where both panels look the same . - For counting tasks : use crop to inspect specific persons or regions more closely when faces are small or occluded . # Tool Use Policy First , observe the given images carefully . Then , based on your observation and reasoning , use the tools based on what is uncertain : - Use ‘ crop ‘ when the target is hard to see , small , densely surrounded by other objects , or requires reading local details . - Use ‘ compare_lr ‘ for spot - the - difference tasks : when you have a candidate difference on the LEFT panel , call ‘ compare_lr ‘ on it to see that region side by side with the same region of the RIGHT panel . crop and verify_part both return an enlarged region, but differ in intent: the former is used to examine detail, the latter to confirm a candidate answer. verify draws proposed boxes on the original image, allowing the agent to assess and refine a localization against its surrounding context.
All three may be called repeatedly within a trajectory.

Boxes must lie within the left panel.
The python tool is provided with the original image and all tool-returned images as preloaded variables, along with numpy , PIL , cv2 , scipy , math , json , and copy . It returns an image only when the executed code produces one.
